creative_direction: Design an original 40-year-old man with a short beard and a gently amused expression, wearing a thick knitted hood that coils above the head like a compact spiral. Use warm side light against a muted plum-gray field. Keep the hood controlled within the frame and the eyes unobstructed, with no fashion logos, fantasy symbols, or excessive decorative stitching. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
